build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run build && cargo build --release --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -p servora-helper

security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: asset: http://asset.localhost; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost
security.devCsp: default-src 'self' http://localhost:1420; img-src 'self' data: asset: http://asset.localhost http://localhost:1420; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' http://localhost:1420; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' http://localhost:1420; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost ws://localhost:1420 ws://localhost:1421 http://localhost:1420

bundle.longDescription: Servora is a lightweight desktop application for managing local development environments on Fedora: Apache HTTP Server, PHP-FPM and MariaDB through systemd and Polkit, plus a website manager that writes Apache VirtualHosts, hosts entries, ACLs and SELinux file contexts.
